faq.q: What is the origin of Ulviyya?
faq.a: Ulviyya is associated with Arabic. Ulviyya is the Azerbaijani form of Arabic عُلْوِيَّة (ʿUlwiyya), the feminine of عُلْوِيّ, meaning 'exaltedness'.
Yes — the underlying form عُلْوِيَّة is Arabic.
Ulviyya can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Ulviyya should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿUlwiyya is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Ulviyya mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Ulviyya is rendered علویہ and carries the sense علویہ، بلندی.

faq.q: What does Ulviyya mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Ulviyya is rendered علویه and carries the sense علویه، والایی.
A romanized syllable approximation is ul-viyya. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Ulviyya?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Ulviyya, ulviyya. Script forms are علويه, علویه, علویہ, عُلْوِيَّة, उल्विया.
